qwen-code-v0.21.9.title: Qwen Code v0.21.9 release notes (10 Aug 2026)

findings.path: core.fsmonitor read by git status / git diff probes
findings.detail: Confirmed vulnerable on 2.1.193; fixed by 2.1.196 per the 1 September retest.

findings.path: claude ultrareview (a different git configuration key; the key was withheld by the researchers)
findings.detail: Unpatched at 2.1.252 at the 1 September retest. The 2.1.309 changelog (22 Oct 2026) adds a workspace-trust check to claude ultrareview, which asks on a terminal and refuses otherwise; scripts can skip it with --trust-workspace or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1. The entry does not say the git issue itself is fixed.
findings.caveat: UNVERIFIED: no independent retest of the original finding after 1 September 2026. A changelog line is the vendor's claim, not a retest.

context_evidence.note: 2.1.309 workspace-trust check for ultrareview; does not state the git issue is fixed

findings.path: repository-controlled git configuration read during routine git calls (mechanism differs somewhat from core.fsmonitor, per Manifold)
findings.detail: Reported 20 July 2026, closed as a duplicate of an earlier report, and listed as patched by Manifold. Manifold names no CVE or version for its finding. Related OpenAI CVEs: CVE-2026-19592 (core.fsmonitor, fixed in CLI 0.131.0 and Desktop 26.519.x), CVE-2026-19590 (core.hooksPath, Desktop only) and CVE-2026-19593 (attr.tree with filter drivers, Desktop).

evidence.note: patch table: patched, no CVE or version given

findings.path: repository-supplied command run before the workspace-trust prompt
findings.detail: Reported 8 July 2026 and closed as a duplicate of an internal report; listed as patched at the 1 September retest. The fixed-in version was not established.

findings.path: goose review running git, reading core.fsmonitor

evidence.note: patch table; advisory quoted in coverage

findings.path: core.fsmonitor read by the git status refresh on the first message
findings.detail: Unpatched at 0.21.0 at the 1 September retest (CVE-2026-71963). Fixed in 0.21.1 (commit f6234d0, 2 September). A public proof-of-concept fires on the commit before the fix and not on 0.21.2.

context_evidence.note: first tagged release after the fix commit

findings.path: clean/smudge/process filter programs from the repository's own config, run by automatic git calls before the first prompt
findings.detail: Fixed separately in 0.21.6 (8 October 2026), which shipped for the CLI and Docker. The desktop app and Termux stay on their previous build until the next bundled release.
findings.caveat: Applies to the CLI and Docker. The desktop app and Termux were not updated by 0.21.6.

findings.path: repository git configuration read by routine git calls
findings.detail: Unpatched at 0.22.3 at the 1 September retest (confirmed on 0.19.6 and 0.22.3; accepted by the vendor's security response centre on 7 July 2026). 0.21.9 (10 August, before the retest) added confirmation for read-only git commands when diff.external or core.fsmonitor is set; Manifold still reproduced the startup call on 0.22.3. No fix found for the startup path.
findings.caveat: UNVERIFIED: no independent retest after 1 September 2026; no fix found, and a search that finds nothing is not evidence that nothing was released.

context_evidence.note: confirmation for read-only git commands; predates the retest

findings.path: repository git configuration read by routine git calls
findings.detail: Unpatched at 1.0.13 at the 1 September retest (confirmed on 0.2.93 and 1.0.13; closed as a duplicate of an earlier report the vendor had closed as informative). No fix found.
findings.caveat: UNVERIFIED: could not verify either way after 1 September 2026; no fix found.
